title: Sussur Bloom

sources.title: Sussur Flower Antimagic Field (condition)
markers: | effects = * A sussur tree flower is draining the character of its magical energy, preventing it from casting spells.

summary: An Underdark bloom suppresses spellcasting nearby and powers the Arcane Tower.

fields.Antimagic: Prevents nearby creatures, including the holder, from casting spells. Nonspell magical actions such as Channel Divinity still work. Guidance during dialogue rolls is reported to bypass it.
fields.Arcane Tower: Use a bloom to power the tower, disable some defences and earn Regeneration Inspiration. Disabling Animated Armour or Arcane Turrets with a bloom earns Secrets of the Sussur Tree.
fields.Handling: Wilts outside the Underdark. The source reports that the camp Traveller’s Chest and locked containers preserve it.
fields.Acquisition: Dread Hollow near the large Sussur Tree and the Arcane Tower garden.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
